note: API names unchanged in 0.13.2 RC. The chosen main route needs four of six jobs in each district; CAREER_ACT_1/2/3 still require every job in that district and are optional completion goals. Existing career endings remain supported in legacy saves. No new personal-project or Code Lab achievement is added. Actual Steam registration/unlocks, native-speaker review and icons remain unverified. 2026-10-12: five draft achievements added for the Python/SQL curriculum, finale export and level 10 (FIRST_COMMIT, PYTHON_AUTOMATOR, QUERY_MASTER, FULLSTACK_CREATOR, LOCALHOST_HERO). They are NOT registered in Steamworks; until registered, activation of these ids fails on Steam while in-game achievements still work.
